description: Checks before posting whether a post in this subreddit can go through. Returns `allowed` (true, false or 'unknown'), `reasons` (each with a `code` such as banned, private, restricted_approved_only, archived, flair_required, title_rule, domain_blocked, low_karma_hint, new_account_hint, and a readable `detail`), the subreddit's posting `requirements` and post `rules`. A read that failed answers 'unknown', not true; karma and account age only produce hints, because subreddits keep their AutoModerator thresholds private. Standard read price. Example: name='SaaS'.

name.description: Subreddit name, without r/ (1 to 21 letters, digits or underscores). Required (path parameter).

name: reddit_subreddit_can_post
title: Subreddit Posting Eligibility
